从工作主要发生的位置出发：本机任务控制台选择桌面 App，终端与脚本选择 CLI: Start where the work happens: desktop App for local task control, CLI for terminals and scripts, IDE integration for the current file and selection, and Cloud for remote repositories and isolated environments. Entry points can hand work off; choose the one closest to context and easiest to review.
先看工作发生在哪里，再选 Codex 入口: Start with where the work happens, then choose a Codex entry point
不是能力排行榜，也不是四选一；优先选离当前上下文最近、最容易审查结果的入口。: Not a capability ranking or a one-of-four choice. Prefer the entry point closest to context and easiest to review.
这次工作主要发生在哪里？: Where does this work mainly happen?
任务管理 · 终端 · 编辑器 · 远程仓库: Task management · terminal · editor · remote repository
适合：第一次上手、长任务: Best for: first use and long tasks
贴近 Git 与测试命令: Close to Git and test commands
适合：终端用户、自动化: Best for: terminal users and automation
适合：远程协作、异步工作: Best for: remote and asynchronous work
入口可以接力: Entry points can hand work off
IDE 澄清局部 → App / Cloud 承接长任务 → CLI 跑团队命令: Clarify locally in IDE → hand long work to App / Cloud → run team commands in CLI → return to diff review
选择后，用一次读取、修改、diff、验证和权限判断完成真实闭环。: Complete a real loop of reading, editing, diff review, verification, and permission decisions.
任务提示和项目规则进入 Codex 任务；Skills 提供流程，MCP 提供外: Task prompts and project rules enter a Codex task; Skills provide processes, MCP external tools, subagents parallel exploration, and Hooks lifecycle guards. Plugins distribute capabilities, Scheduled tasks trigger by time, and people review final output.
规则、流程、工具、守护、分发和触发围绕一次任务协同，不是彼此替代的等级。: Rules, processes, tools, guards, distribution, and triggers collaborate around one task; they are not replacement tiers.
按时间触发新的运行: Trigger a new run by time
理解目标 · 维护计划 · 汇总证据: Understand goal · maintain plan · consolidate evidence
权限由宿主与服务控制: Permissions controlled by host and service
运行前检查 · 工具调用策略 · 运行后审计: Pre-run checks · tool-call policy · post-run audit
可以记录、补上下文或阻断；不负责定义任务目标: Can log, add context, or block; does not define task goals
Plugin：把 Skills、连接器、MCP、Hooks 和任务模板组合、安装: Plugin: compose, install, and distribute Skills, connectors, MCP, Hooks, and task templates
它位于分发层，不是运行链路的最后一步: Distribution layer, not final execution step
从要持久化的对象出发选择机制：单次任务用提示词，项目规则用 AGENTS.md，: Choose by what must persist: prompt for one task, AGENTS.md for project rules, Skill for reusable process, MCP for external tools, Hook for lifecycle guards, Plugin for distribution, Scheduled task for repetition.
先问“要持久化什么”，再选扩展机制: Ask what must persist, then choose an extension mechanism
这些机制可以组合，但职责不同；不要把它们误解成从低到高的升级阶梯。: These mechanisms combine but have different responsibilities; they are not an upgrade ladder.
指令 · 规则 · 流程 · 工具 · 触发 · 分发: Instructions · rules · process · tools · trigger · distribution
每次进入项目都要遵守的规则: Rules followed whenever the project is opened
在生命周期节点检查或阻断: Check or block at lifecycle points
也可包含 Hooks 与任务模板: May include Hooks and task templates
常见组合：AGENTS.md 定规则 + Skill 定流程 + MCP 提供工: Common: AGENTS.md rules + Skill process + MCP tools + Hook boundaries
Plugin 负责分发，Scheduled task 负责定时触发: Plugin distributes; Scheduled task triggers by time
Codex Hook 生命周期与关键事件: Codex Hook lifecycle and key events
会话由 SessionStart 开始。任务轮次中先提交 UserPromptS: A session begins with SessionStart. UserPromptSubmit precedes PreToolUse and tool execution; PermissionRequest fires only for approval. PostToolUse follows completion, Stop may request another turn, compaction has Pre/Post events, subagents have start/stop events, and SessionEnd runs only for the main thread.
先判断副作用发生前还是发生后，再选择事件；Hook 是额外守护层，不是完整安全边: Choose by whether side effects occur before or after the event. Hooks are additional guards, not a complete security boundary.
一次工具调用与任务轮次: One tool call and task turn
多个来源的匹配 Hook 都会运行；同一事件的 command Hook 可并发: Matching Hooks from all sources run; command Hooks may start concurrently
项目与 Plugin Hook 需要审查和信任，变更 hash 后重新审查: Project and Plugin Hooks require review and trust; review again after hash changes
Codex 沙箱与审批判断流程: Codex sandbox and approval decision flow
Codex 为完成任务提出动作，先判断是否处于沙箱范围内。范围内可执行并留下证据: Codex proposes an action and checks the sandbox. In-scope actions run with evidence; out-of-scope actions request a human decision. Denial narrows or explains; approval permits only the stated action. Both paths end in verification.
沙箱管“最多到哪里”，审批管“越界前是否询问”: Sandbox controls maximum reach; approval controls whether to ask before crossing it
任务约束描述意图；系统边界约束执行；diff、测试和外部状态负责最终验收。: Task constraints describe intent; system boundaries constrain execution; diffs, tests, and external state determine acceptance.
询问用户或按策略拒绝: Ask user or deny by policy
子进程也受同一沙箱约束: Child processes use the same sandbox
验证结果与外部副作用: Verify results and external side effects
diff · 测试 · 日志 · 远端状态 · 可恢复性: diff · tests · logs · remote state · recoverability
没有弹窗不等于无需审查；获得批准也不等于结果正确。: No prompt does not remove review; approval does not prove correctness.
先定义耐久任务并手动验证，再选择独立任务或聊天内任务、Web 上下文或桌面本地项: Define and verify a durable task, choose standalone/in-chat and Web/local context. Run unattended in the default sandbox, review in Scheduled, adjust errors, end on no change, and wait for a person before high-risk writes.
从手动验证到安全定时运行: From manual verification to safe scheduled execution
调度只负责再次触发；稳定输入、最小权限、停止条件和人工复核必须写进任务。: Scheduling only retriggers the task; stable inputs, least privilege, stop conditions, and human review must be written into it.
先写清每次都要做什么: First state what every run must do
按运行是否相互独立判断: Choose by whether runs are independent
本地任务需机器与 App 在线: Local tasks require computer + App online
保留运行证据与未读状态: Preserve run evidence and unread state
结果过宽、材料不足或频率不合适：调整后重新手动验证: If results are too broad, material is missing, or frequency is wrong: adjust and verify manually again
每次运行必须明确三条路径: Every run must define three paths
有发现：交付证据 · 无变化：简短结束 · 无法完成：停止并等待人工: Finding: deliver evidence · no change: end briefly · unable: stop and wait for a person
主 Agent 持有全局目标、用户约束和权限模式，把边界清楚的只读探索、测试定位: The main Agent retains goals, constraints, and permissions while delegating bounded work. Subagents inherit the sandbox and may share a workspace; they return evidence for conflict resolution, merging, and final verification.
主 Agent 编排，子 Agent 聚焦，证据回到主线程验收: Main Agent orchestrates, subagents focus, evidence returns to the main thread for acceptance
优先并行只读、边界清楚的工作；上下文隔离不代表文件隔离，写任务必须另划所有权。: Parallelize bounded read-only work first. Context isolation is not file isolation; write tasks need separate ownership.
用户目标 · 约束 · 计划 · 权限模式: User goal · constraints · plan · permission mode
定义子任务契约，决定是否采用结果，负责最终答复: Define subtask contracts, decide whether to adopt results, own the final response
交付：调用链与文件位置: Deliver: call chain and file locations
可与其他只读任务并行: Can run with other read-only tasks
沙箱与权限模式从主任务继承；多个 Agent 可能看到同一工作区: Sandbox and permission mode inherit from the main task; several Agents may see one workspace
并行写同一文件会冲突：按目录 / 组件 / 工作树分配所有权，再由主线程合并。: Concurrent writes to one file conflict: assign ownership by directory, component, or worktree, then merge in the main thread.
主 Agent 汇总、处理冲突并验证: Main Agent consolidates, resolves conflicts, and verifies
比较证据 → 决定修改 → 合并 → 重跑测试与构建: Compare evidence → decide edits → merge → rerun tests and build
子任务完成不是总任务完成；最终结论只由可复核证据支撑。: Subtask completion is not task completion; only reproducible evidence supports the final conclusion.
从任务说明到可验证结果的闭环: Loop from task specification to verifiable result
目标、背景、输入、约束、验收和权限构成任务说明。Codex 依次探索、计划、执行: Goal, background, inputs, constraints, acceptance, and permissions form the task. Codex explores, plans, executes, and verifies; failure returns with evidence and success delivers.
从任务说明到可验证结果: From task specification to verifiable result
好提示词不是终点，它要把执行、证据和反馈接成一个闭环。: A good prompt is not the endpoint; it connects execution, evidence, and feedback into a loop.
信息不足时先问，不要猜: Ask when information is missing; do not guess
不通过：带着失败证据返回任务说明或计划: Fail: return to the task or plan with failure evidence
先运行测试稳定复现红灯，记录失败证据；再定位根因并做最小修复，运行相关测试得到绿: Reproduce stable red and record evidence; locate root cause, make the smallest repair, reach green in related tests, then run full regression and diff review. Failures return to the relevant step.
带验证的 Bug 修复：先红、再绿、再回归: Verified bug fix: red, then green, then regression
测试通过只有在先稳定复现原问题之后，才能成为修复证据。: A passing test becomes repair evidence only after the original issue is reproduced reliably.
证据链：失败命令与断言 → 根因解释 → 最小 diff → 相关测试通过 →: Evidence chain: failing command and assertion → root-cause explanation → minimal diff → related tests pass → full regression passes → human scope review
相关测试失败返回最小修复；全量回归或 diff 审查失败返回根因分析。: Related-test failure returns to the minimal repair; full-regression or diff-review failure returns to root-cause analysis.
